proposal: The Mandate recommends that DOL repromulgate the first-term staffing flexibility rule so state agencies can use contractors or other staff rather than only state employees for Wagner-Peyser Employment Service work, and that Congress codify it. It adds that the federal government should not force a state to use non-union or union labor for these positions.

status_summary: ETA proposed on 2025-07-01 to remove the requirement that states use state merit staff for Employment Service work. On 2026-01-21 it delayed the 2023 rule's compliance date by one year to 2027-01-21. A final rule published 2026-08-20 deletes the merit-staffing provision in 20 CFR 652.215 and is effective 2026-10-19, so it was not yet operative on 2026-10-13. Codification by Congress was not found.
